props.children: Everything the library builds is described by JSON objects, the meta of the app. Pages, layouts, tables and forms are files under meta/; the app reads them at startup and builds itself from them.

A base app on React, Hono and SQLite, the whole shadcn/ui component set, and a runtime that turns a short description into routes, navigation, pages and grids. A model writes the descriptions; the schema keeps it honest.
This page, its header, sidebar and footer are all meta: meta/layouts/docs.json and meta/pages/introduction.json.
